what: Author describes using ChatGPT to write ebook content and Canva for design, creating an ebook titled "30 AI Tools That Save 10 Hours a Week" priced at $15, then uploading the PDF to Gumroad. States first draft was completed in one hour.
verbatim_snippet: Stated in layout: "I opened ChatGPT and had my first draft done in an hour. [Section: My First eBook] I didn't make it complicated. My first eBook was: '30 AI Tools That Save 10 Hours a Week.' ChatGPT assisted me in writing the content. Canva provided me with a refined design. I charged $15. [Section: Setting Up Shop (Quick & Easy)] Uploaded the PDF on Gumroad. Set up a landing page with a clean cover."
notes: Structured layout flag — article uses section headings between production steps and Gumroad upload steps. Author Imran Kabir. No Gumroad product link provided in article. Same page describes scaling to two additional ebooks ("Freelancer's AI Toolkit" at $19, "The Remote Work Productivity Bible" at $25) and a $45 bundle.
